newsitem.title: UK: Hambro Countrywide to buy RPT Mgt.
newsitem.headline: Hambro Countrywide to buy RPT Mgt.

text.p: British estate agency Hambro Countrywide Plc said on Friday it had agreed terms of a purchase of London-based property managers RPT Management which values the company at approximately 8.4 million stg.

"The acquisition of RPT will bring to Hambro Countrywide an established and successful branded property lettings business and management agency in central London, an area where Hambro Countrywide is not currently represented," the company said in a statement.
The offer is based on 114 pence cash for each RPT ordinary share, with a loan note alternative and with shareholders being entitled to retain RPT's interim dividend payment of 1.5 pence.
RPT shares closed at 114-1/2 pence on Friday, with Hambro Countrywide closing at 95-3/4 pence, up a penny on the day.
